# Overlap catalogue (generated by karaceing-generator/initstate.py)

Every correspondence tagged `overlap` in the initial state, with its kind, where it comes from and the scenario
tests whose source code names one of the two elements. The kinds are motivated by the KA-RaceIng scenarios of the
*Inconsistency Scenarios* TechReport (R1-R10, see REPORT_SCENARIOS.md); the rules AR1-AR13 are implemented in
`KARaceIngOverlapRules` (consistency module) and run in the generated `Overlap<Src>To<Tgt>` reactions.

## Kinds

| Kind | Overlap | Report scenarios | Rule | Count |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| K1 | CAD geometry / mass -> SIM parameters | R1 (mass, inertia, heat capacity of the vented disc), R7 | AR2: mass, inertia, heat capacity and venting are derived from the CAD geometry and written to the block parameters | 12 |
| K2 | CAD <-> THERMO thermal model | R1 (cooling of the vented disc), R3 (piston) | AR2/AR6: material and geometry changes update the thermal model or notify the thermodynamics engineer | 13 |
| K3 | CAD <-> ELEC mounting / packaging | R2 (mounting interfaces of the two-piece caliper), R9 | AR4: Device.mountingPosition names the CAD element; renames are propagated, moves are notified | 17 |
| K4 | CAD part <-> BOM item | R1, R2, R4 (the ordered part is the designed part) | AR2: mass, material and specification of the item are derived from the CAD part | 102 |
| K5 | Brake specification <-> CAD / BOM / SIM / ELEC | R1 (ventilated), R2 (monobloc / two-piece), R6, R7 (wear) | AR1/AR3/AR12: specification attributes are propagated to BOM and SIM, CAD mismatches are notified | 18 |
| K6 | BOM supplier / material data <-> THERMO | R3 (supplier change of the caliper pistons) | AR6: supplier and material of the item update the thermal component (material table), analyses become outdated | 2 |
| K7 | Artefact <-> validation (test cases, limits) | R2 (assembly build), R3 (temperature limit), R4, R5 (compliance) | AR7/AR8/AR10: limits and pass criteria are updated, the validation engineer is notified | 19 |
| K8 | ELEC signals <-> SIM control model | R6 (integrated ABS/BOTS unit), R9 (new BOTS sensor) | AR11: pins and signals of the device are the signal parameters of the block; new devices get a block | 16 |
| K9 | CAD <-> CAD across roles (shared space, mass) | R1 (FT-08 aerodynamics, FT-09 kinematics), constraints | AR2: the other CAD role is notified (mass difference for KIN; notification only for AERO) | 8 |
| K10 | KIN tyres <-> SIM tyre parameter sets | R8 (intermediate tyre) | AR13: a new tyre set gets a parameter set initialised from the existing sets | 3 |
| K11 | ELEC component <-> BOM item | R2 (step 7), R6 | AR5: the part number of the device is the part number of the item | 7 |

Sources: evolution scenario 18, interface constraint 36, physical part 109, report scenario 54
